title: Ease Pass plugin manifest (manifest.json inside an .epplugin package)
description: Informational data about a plugin. Nothing in this file grants abilities: permissions and types are computed by the host from the Wasm component. Unknown properties are ignored.

id.description: Globally unique id in reverse-DNS form, lower case. Also the package file name (<id>.epplugin) and the name of the plugin's storage directory.

version.description: Semantic version of the plugin (major.minor.patch with optional pre-release).

api_version.description: Major version of the easepass:plugin WIT package the plugin was built against.

os.description: Operating systems the plugin works on. Missing or empty = all.

network_hosts.description: Hosts the plugin may reach through the network permission, shown to the user and ENFORCED by the host. Each entry is 'host:port'. host is a DNS name, '*.domain' (any subdomain, not the domain itself), an IPv4 address, a bracketed IPv6 address, or '*' (any host: needed when the user configures the server; shown as a high-risk warning). port is 1-65535 or '*'. Ignored without the network permission.

permissions.description: Optional and informational. If present it MUST equal the set the host computes from the component's imports, otherwise the install is rejected.
